title: Buccaneers at Cowboys Initial Injury Report: Winfield to miss 2-4 weeks

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Buccaneers at Cowboys Initial Injury Report: Winfield to miss 2-4 weeks
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers released their initial injury report Monday ahead of Thursday night’s matchup against the Dallas Cowboys, and the biggest news involves star safety Antoine Winfield, Jr. Winfield did not participate due to a rib injury suffered late in Sunday’s 17-14 loss to the Green Bay Packers. Head coach Todd Bowles revealed Monday […]
